title: 1-507th Parachute Infantry Regiment Soldiers Take to the Sky
description:
U.S. Army Soldiers from the 1st Battalion, 507th Parachute Infantry Regiment took to the skies for a water jump into Walter F. George Lake, supporrted by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Mobile District, and Georgia Department of Natural Resources. (U.S. Army video by Rydell Tomas Jr.)
